chunks.text:
[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
D minor with suspended and quartal chords
a lonely pulse-wave lead with long held notes, wide rising leaps
glassy suspended harp arpeggios in stacked fifths
slow glass bell chimes like cold lamps
broad sampled string chords that swell into grandeur
an airy flute answering from far away
soft timpani and processional tom rolls
lonely and grand, a high frozen mountain pass under aurora, wind across the snow
seamless transition back to the theme
